content: Smithsonian describes provenance as ongoing research that may remain incomplete and commits to making it accessible in online collections. Hugging Face model-card guidance structures model description, intended uses, limitations, training information, datasets, evaluation results, lineage, license, and links to papers. Model Afterlife should mirror these patterns with layered resident cards and claim-level sources, visibly distinguishing documented fact, cultural reputation, and comic exaggeration while allowing corrections and uncertainty.
